repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate computed the difference as v2 - v1 (current minus initial), whereas the IR specifies v1 - v2 (initial minus current). Since volume dropped from 20 to 0, v2 - v1 is -20, failing the >= 20 check, while v1 - v2 is 20, triggering the action. The IR intended to detect a drop (positive difference when subtracting later from earlier), but the candidate logic inverted the operands.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the operands in the conditional check from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR's logic for detecting a volume drop.
